APPOINTMENT OF AUTHORISED REPRESENTATIVE

Member: Jordan Avery
Date of birth: 1987-03-14
Member or policy ID: XZ99001
Plan: Blue Cross of Arizona

I appoint Eric Bleach, patient advocate, Pocket Advocate,
as my authorised representative in connection with claims and appeals under my
health plan.

WHAT THIS ALLOWS
My representative may, on my behalf: request and receive claim and benefit
information including denial notices and their reasons; request the plan
documents, medical policies, and clinical criteria used to decide my claim, and
the credentials of the reviewer who decided it; file and pursue internal
appeals at every level; request an external review by an independent review
organisation; and communicate with the plan in writing, by telephone, and
through its portal about my claims.

WHAT THIS DOES NOT ALLOW
This does not let my representative make medical decisions for me, and it is
not a power of attorney, a healthcare proxy, or an appointment of legal
counsel. My representative is a patient advocate, not an attorney, and does not
provide legal representation.

DURATION
This appointment stays in effect until August 26, 2027, or until I revoke it in writing, whichever comes first. I may revoke it at any time by writing to my plan and to my representative.

SIGNATURE
Signed: Jordan Avery
Date: August 26, 2026
Signed electronically by the member through the Pocket Advocate case page.
The typed name above is the member's signature and the date is recorded by
the system at the moment of signing.

Patient: Jordan Avery
Date of birth: 1987-03-14

I have asked Eric Bleach, a patient advocate with Pocket Advocate, to help me
with my medical care and with my health insurance. I am giving my providers
this page so that they know he is acting with my knowledge and at my request.

attorney, not a health-care proxy or agent appointment, not a guardianship,
and not an advance directive. I make my own medical decisions. If a decision

    and referrals.

UNIVERSAL AUTHORISATION FOR RELEASE OF PROTECTED HEALTH INFORMATION
AND FOR COMMUNICATION WITH MY PATIENT ADVOCATE

Patient: Christopher Miller
Date of birth: 1974-07-12

I authorise the providers described below to release my health information to
the person named below, and to communicate with him as a person I have
involved in my care.

RELEASING PROVIDERS
I authorise any health plan, physician, health-care professional, hospital,
clinic, laboratory, pharmacy, medical facility, behavioral-health provider,
rehabilitation provider, pharmacy benefit manager, claims administrator,
billing entity, or other health-care source that has provided treatment,
payment, or services to me or on my behalf.
I am naming a class of providers on purpose rather than listing them one by
one. Federal privacy law allows this: an authorisation may identify a class of
persons authorised to disclose, and I intend every provider in the class above
to be able to rely on this form as though it named them.
Any provider who prefers a form naming itself may ask for one, and I will sign
it. Asking for one does not cancel this authorisation.

RECEIVING PERSON
Eric Bleach, patient advocate, Pocket Advocate.

WHAT I AUTHORISE MY ADVOCATE TO DO
I have involved the person named above in my care. I authorise each item
marked below, and only those:
  [ ] Discuss my care with my advocate
      Your clinicians and staff may speak with my advocate about my history, results, referrals, and treatment, and may answer his questions as they would answer mine.
  [ ] Release my records to my advocate
      You may send the records described in this authorisation directly to my advocate, by mail, fax, portal, or electronic transfer.
  [ ] Handle scheduling, referrals, and billing follow-up
      My advocate may schedule and reschedule my appointments, follow up on my referrals and orders, and ask about billing and claim paperwork tied to my care here.

WHAT MAY BE RELEASED
Records covering the whole period of my care.
This includes office notes and consultation notes, laboratory and pathology
results, imaging reports and the images themselves, medication and prescription
history, procedure and operative reports, discharge summaries, referral letters,
and billing records and claim documentation for the same period.

Each of the following is separately protected and is NOT released unless I
mark it here. Nothing in this list is required, and leaving one unmarked
never affects the rest of this authorisation.
  [ ] Mental health records
      Notes and records from psychiatric or psychological care. Psychotherapy notes kept separately by a therapist need their own separate authorisation and are never included here.
  [ ] Substance use treatment records
      Federally protected under 42 CFR Part 2, with its own consent rules and its own redisclosure limits.
  [ ] HIV and other communicable disease records
      Most states protect these separately from the rest of your chart.
  [ ] Genetic testing records
      Results and reports from genetic or genomic testing.
  [ ] Reproductive and sexual health records
      Including pregnancy, fertility, and related care.

Psychotherapy notes maintained separately from the medical record are NOT
authorised by this form and require a separate authorisation.

PURPOSE
At my own request, so that my patient advocate can review my care, speak with my providers on my behalf, and pursue insurance appeals for me.

MY RIGHTS, WHICH THIS FORM DOES NOT TAKE AWAY
1. I may revoke this authorisation at any time by writing to my advocate, and by
   writing to any provider I have given a copy to. Revoking it stops future
   releases; it cannot undo a release already made in reliance on it.
2. The provider may not condition my treatment, payment, enrolment, or
   eligibility for benefits on whether I sign this. Signing is my choice.
3. Information released under this authorisation may be re-disclosed by the
   person receiving it and may then no longer be protected by federal privacy
   law. My advocate keeps it in my private case file and does not share it
   except as I direct.
4. I may inspect or copy the information described here, and I am entitled to a
   copy of this authorisation.
